assertions.name: symmetrizer_eig_matches_v9_uniqueness_band
assertions.source: The Hecke symmetrizer trivial-rep eigenvalue at q_0 MUST match v9's needed correction to within 0.11% (the band PR #1581 Probe C established as unique).

description: Verifies that (1+q)/2 is exactly the trivial-rep eigenvalue of the Hecke symmetrizer (1+T_s)/2 in H_n(q). At q_0, this scalar matches v9's needed multiplicative correction to 0.0958% — the same uniqueness band found in PR #1581 Probe C. Categorical labeling becomes a verified Hecke-algebra fact (still not a derivation of WHY this projector appears in the v8 mirror-pair formula).

data.interpretation: (1+q)/2 IS the Hecke symmetrizer (1+T_s)/2 trivial-rep eigenvalue. This UPGRADES C's audit-body labeling from a loose categorical description to a verified Hecke-algebra identity. v9's needed correction at q_0 matches this scalar to 0.096% — the SAME uniqueness band C found. NOT a derivation of why the symmetrizer should appear in the v8 mirror-pair formula — that requires structural work on the v8 formula's origin in Reeb-phase / Casimir difference.
